title: Dell security advisory (AV26-821)
content_md: Serial Number: AV26-821 Date: August 17, 2026 As of August 14, 2026, Dell is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: PowerFlex appliance Prior to 51.391.02 and 51.384.02 PowerFlex Rack Prior to 3.9.1.2 and 3.8.4.2 PowerFlex Software Prior to 5.1.0.2 and 4.5.6 Dell Client Platform for Multiple AMD BIOS multiple versions and models Dell Client Platform BIOS for 2026.3 IPU multiple versions and models Dell VPlex Prior to 6.2.2.1 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply any necessary updates as they become available.
